verdict.rationale: The evidence shows standard analytics, such as open/click tracking 'insights into recipient engagement', and an MCP server that lets an external AI assistant query delivery stats. Neither is an AI-generated insight or suggestion feature inside Mailgun itself: the MCP server is a building block for outside assistants, and the engagement tracking is not AI-driven. 'Send time optimization' appears only as a pricing-page line item and is never described as AI-generated insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
